data.name: Mushroom Road

heroImage.alt: A cozy mushroom-themed adventure with a snail and a hedgehog traveler on a forest path leading to a colorful mushroom festival

data.fullDescription: Mushroom Road — a casual adventure about a snail traveling to the Great Mushroom Festival. You walk, hitch rides and trade stories with other travelers along the road. Each stop adds something to your backpack and a new rumor about the festival. It's slow, but that is the point.
